name: 22209 · Arlington, VA
findings: ZIP 22209 (Arlington) has 196 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22209 (Arlington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
